issue_context.title: System.Drawing.Font.GetHashCode() return is not unique because it does not include the fontName
issue_context.body:
_This issue has been moved from [a ticket on Developer Community](https://developercommunity2.visualstudio.com/t/SystemDrawingFontGetHashCode-return/998779)._ ---

System.Drawing.Font.GetHashCode hashes the fontStyle, fontUnit, and fontSize, but does not hash the fontName. Thus, New Font("Arial", 16, FontStyle.Bold, GraphicsUnit.Point). GetHashCode() returns the same value as New Font("Lucida Sans Unicode", 16, FontStyle.Bold, GraphicsUnit.Point). GetHashCode()
